name: SSHDrops
author: FlyingBassHot
description: A bar panel for saved SSH hosts: fuzzy search, live session status, and one-click connect.

barWidget.description: Saved SSH hosts with fuzzy search, live session status, and one-click connect from the bar.

schema.label: Default connect mode
schema.description: Shell runs ssh directly. Shell + reconnect routes through Omarchy's bash ssh() wrapper, which cleans up terminal modes and retries after a dropped session.

schema.label: Show host count in the bar
schema.description: Show the saved-host count next to the icon.

schema.label: Session poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to rescan for live SSH sessions. Sessions are also rescanned whenever the panel opens.

schema.label: Offer ~/.ssh/config import
schema.description: Show the import button that reads Host aliases out of ~/.ssh/config. Imported hosts store only the alias, so OpenSSH still applies IdentityFile, ProxyJump, and Match rules from your own config.
